#include <string>

        s.replace(pos_at, 2, "@");

    string result = s;
    for (size_t i = 1; i < result.length() - 2; ++i) {
        if (result[i] == 'a' && result[i+1] == 't') {
            result.replace(i, 2, "@");
            break;
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 1; i < result.length() - 3; ++i) {
        if (result[i] == 'd' && result[i+1] == 'o' && result[i+2] == 't') {
            result.replace(i, 3, ".");
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int main(){
    while (cin >> s){
        cout << f() << endl;
    }
}
